name: Borderlands Tabard
descriptionHtml: While you're wearing this tabard, NPCs in the Keep on the Borderlands are initially Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly toward you.

name: Cultist's Robe
descriptionHtml: While wearing this occult outfit, you have Advantage|XPHB on any ability check you make to impersonate a cultist in the Cult of Chaos.
